title: Nifty breaks its 200-day average on a weekly basis

timeline.title: Nifty breaks its 200-day average on a weekly basis
timeline.line: The first such breach in six years; the seven-week slide has wiped out about $250 bn
more: The index is at its lowest close since early April
It is on course for an eighth straight weekly decline
Oil, foreign outflows and a lack of AI-linked plays are cited

src.title: Bloomberg — Indian stocks break key support levels as selloff wipes out $250 billion
